dmp.description: This DMP supports the research project aimed at exploring the architecture of educational governance in post-war Ukraine. It outlines data collection, storage, versioning, sharing, and ethical management strategies within a human-centered and inclusive educational reform context.

project.description: An individual doctoral research project on educational governance mechanisms in transitional societies, conducted at the National University of Kyiv-Mohyla Academy
project.title: Educational Governance in Transition (PhD Dissertation)

dmp.title: Educational governance mechanisms in transition as a cornerstone for sustainable peace
